    • isLtvReady

      public boolean isLtvReady()
      The core's document-level readiness verdict. The current core requires DSS, VRI entries and OCSP/CRL material; it does not require DSS/VRI certificates or validate every signature. This is not a PAdES-LT validation verdict.
      Returns:
      the document-level material-readiness flag; use signature validation for an LT/LTA verdict
